title: TOLAP Policy Assignment
description: Links a TOLAP policy definition to a user, group, role, or service account. Assignments are scoped, time-bound, and audited.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for validation tooling.

version.description: TOLAP schema version. Must be '1.0' for this schema.

policyName.description: Name of the policy definition this assignment references. Must match a policy definition's 'name' field.

assignee.description: The entity receiving this policy assignment.

type.description: Type of assignee. user: individual user. group: identity provider group. role: application role. serviceAccount: machine identity.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for the assignee. Format depends on type: UUID for users, group name for groups, role name for roles, service account ID for service accounts.

tenantId.description: Tenant this assignment applies to. If omitted, applies to all tenants the assignee belongs to.

sourceConnectionId.description: Specific data source connection this assignment applies to. If omitted, applies to all sources matched by the policy's sourcePatterns.

active.description: Whether this assignment is currently active. Inactive assignments are ignored during policy resolution.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this assignment expires. After expiry, the assignment is treated as inactive. Omit for assignments that do not expire.

audit.description: Audit trail for this assignment. All fields are mandatory.

grantedBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this assignment.

grantedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this assignment was created.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this assignment was granted.
